events.place: Midlands Prison / Portlaoise Prison campus, Co. Laois
events.summary: A drone carrying contraband for Midlands Prison crashed into the roof of the nearby Prison Officers' Training College. Two men were arrested; a man in his 30s was charged, a man in his 40s released pending a file. A package of phones and suspected cannabis and tablets was recovered.
events.payload_detail: mobile phones, suspected cannabis and tablets
events.source_title: Seizure of Drone, Suspected Drugs and Mobile Phones, Portlaoise, Co Laois, 6th October 2026
events.quote: Gardaí attached to the Laois Drugs Unit and Laois Detective Unit intercepted a drone flying in close proximity to the Portlaoise Prison Campus, Co Laois, this afternoon Tuesday 6th October 2026.

events.summary: Dimitrije Dragovic's sentence for conspiring to smuggle a drone, phones and drugs into a prison increased on Attorney General referral from 2y2m to 3y4m. Bag held a drone with range over three miles, cannabis, tobacco, phones, SIM cards.
events.payload_detail: cannabis, tobacco, mobile phones, SIM cards, dongles, charging equipment
events.source_title: Sentence increase for man plotting to smuggle drugs into prison
events.quote: The bag contained a drone with a range of over three miles

events.summary: Police stopped a taxi in Niš and found a 49-year-old man with a pistol (eight rounds) and a drone with remote control, suspected of planning to fly the pistol into the Niš correctional facility; arrested.
events.payload_detail: pistol with eight rounds
events.source_title: Nišlija uhapšen sa pištoljem i dronom: Sumnja se da je oružje hteo da ubaci u zatvor
events.quote: Nišlija D.R. (49) uhapšen je zbog sumnje da je putem drona nameravao da unese pištolj u Kazneno-popravni zavod u tom gradu, u čemu ga je policija sprečila, saopštila je Policijska uprava.
events.quote_translation: D.R. (49) from Niš was arrested on suspicion of intending to bring a pistol into the correctional facility in that city by drone, which the police prevented, the Police Directorate said.

events.summary: Border Guard officers from Bobrowniki detained two Belarusian and one Polish national collecting contraband flown from Belarus by drones: four packages of cigarettes with Belarusian excise stamps worth about PLN 95,000. Charged; three months' pretrial detention.
events.payload_detail: 4 packages of cigarettes, approx PLN 95,000
events.source_title: Przemycali papierosy drogą powietrzną
events.quote: Funkcjonariusze z Placówki SG w Bobrownikach zatrzymali 2 obywateli Białorusi oraz 1 obywatela Polski, którzy w rejon miejscowości przygranicznych przyjechali celem odebrania kontrabandy przemyconej z Białorusi do Polski, za pomocą bezzałogowych statków powietrznych tzw. dronów.
events.quote_translation: Officers from the Bobrowniki SG post detained 2 Belarusian citizens and 1 Polish citizen who came to border localities to collect contraband smuggled from Belarus to Poland by unmanned aircraft, so-called drones.

events.summary: Ronanstown Gardaí seized two drones, a mobile device and €7,000 of controlled drugs on 27-28 March 2026 in an operation on supply into prisons. Three men aged 20s-30s were arrested and charged.
events.payload_detail: controlled drugs valued €7,000
events.source_title: Operation Tara / Operation Throwover - Gardaí seize Two Drones and €7,000 Controlled Drugs, West Dublin, 30th March 2026
events.quote: As part of as part of ongoing operations targeting the supply of controlled substances into prisons in the West Dublin area, Ronanstown Gardaí have arrested three men, and seized two drones and €7,000 controlled drugs

events.place: Alcalá de los Gazules, Vejer de la Frontera, Tarifa, Algeciras, San Roque (Cádiz)
events.summary: Operation Ruche: Guardia Civil with Royal Moroccan Gendarmerie arrested nine members of a group flying home-built fixed-wing drones (range over 200 km) from Alcalá de los Gazules to Morocco and back, dropping hashish near Vejer and Tarifa. 8 drones seized, 10 more in assembly; 210 kg hashish and EUR 320,000 seized.
events.payload_detail: 210 kg hashish seized; about 200 kg per night introduced
events.source_title: Detenida una organización criminal que utilizaba drones de ala fija para el tráfico de drogas en el Estrecho
events.quote: La Guardia Civil ha detenido a una organización criminal dedicada a la introducción de hachís desde Marruecos a través del Estrecho mediante el uso de drones artesanales ensamblados por los propios integrantes del grupo.
events.quote_translation: The Guardia Civil has arrested a criminal organisation dedicated to bringing hashish in from Morocco across the Strait using home-made drones assembled by the group's own members.

events.summary: Ronanstown Gardaí and Operation Throwover searched a Clondalkin residence and seized a drone and a package wrapped for conveyance holding cannabis, cocaine and diamorphine, plus mobile phones. One man in his 50s was arrested and released; file to DPP.
events.payload_detail: cannabis ~€2,300, cocaine €675, diamorphine >€4,000 street value; mobile phones
events.source_title: Gardaí seize over €6,795 worth of drugs and drone in Clondalkin, Dublin, Friday 24th October 2025
events.quote: A domestic residence was searched and as a result a drone along with a package wrapped for conveyance were seized.

events.summary: Counter-drone operation at HMP Wandsworth recovered a drone described by the Ministry of Justice as sophisticated, costing GBP 6,000, 40-minute flight time, able to carry four loads. Combined with HMP Manchester operation, nine arrests.
events.source_title: Counter-drone efforts rise as prison sightings revealed
events.quote: The clampdown has already seen counter-drone operations at HMPs Manchester and Wandsworth

events.place: Wheatfield and Cloverhill prison campus, Clondalkin, and west Dublin search (per Irish Times)
events.summary: Gardaí learned of an attempted drone delivery to a prison and searched a west Dublin house under warrant. A drone and electronic devices were seized. Four men were arrested and released without charge; file to DPP.
events.source_title: Operation Tara - Search and Arrest Operation in West Dublin, 20th April 2025
events.quote: Gardaí from Ronanstown Garda Station became aware of an attempt to carry out a drone delivery to a prison yesterday, Sunday 20th April 2025.

events.summary: Gendarmerie cyber unit dismantled a family-run paid drone-delivery service for inmates, directed from inside the prison; seven arrested on 22 June 2026, 20,500 euro seized. Deliveries charged 150 euro per drone.
events.payload_detail: alcohol, food, cigarettes, narcotics, phones, computer connectors
events.source_title: Démantèlement d’une structure criminelle de livraison par drone en centre pénitentiaire par les cyberenquêteurs de l’UNCyber
events.quote: L’organisation du groupe est similaire à celle des organisations criminelles classiques, avec une répartition des tâches entre les membres d’une équipe
events.quote_translation: The group's organisation resembles classic criminal organisations, with tasks divided among team members.

events.place: Dublin region (Crime South, Lucan and Ronanstown stations)
events.summary: A man and woman, both in their 20s, were arrested under Section 50 of the Criminal Justice Act 2007 in a Garda investigation into a criminal group smuggling drugs and other items into Irish prisons, including by drone. Follows the 8 April 2025 searches.
events.source_title: Man and woman arrested following prison drug smuggling investigation
events.quote: A man and woman were arrested on Monday as part of a Garda investigation into the activities of a criminal group involved in smuggling drugs and other items into Irish prisons.

events.summary: During a border-zone survey in forest in Demene parish, Latvian border guards found a drone with a box of 15,000 NZ Gold cigarettes bearing Belarusian excise stamps. Drone and cigarettes seized; criminal proceedings opened for smuggling in a significant amount.
events.payload_detail: 15,000 NZ Gold cigarettes with Belarusian excise stamps
events.source_title: Robežsargi izņem 15 tūkstošus kontrabandas cigarešu un dronu
events.quote: Veicot pierobežas joslas apsekošanu, robežsargi Demenes pagastā, mežā, konstatēja bezpilota gaisa kuģi (dronu), pie kura apakšā piestiprināta baltā polietilēna plēvē ietīta taisnstūrveida kārba ar kontrabandas cigaretēm.
events.quote_translation: While surveying the border zone, border guards in Demene parish found in a forest an unmanned aircraft (drone) with a rectangular box of contraband cigarettes in white polyethylene film attached to its underside.

events.summary: Guards detected a drone heading for the exercise yards, activated the anti-drone system and the drone crashed near a guard post; an inmate who approached was detained. Bag held five phones with chargers, two routers, three SIM cards, blades, a cutter and a 20 m rope.
events.payload_detail: 5 phones, 2 routers, 3 SIM cards, 5 blades, folding knife, metal cutter, 20 m rope
events.source_title: Drone Attempts to Smuggle Illegal Cargo into Chania Prison
events.quote: Correctional officers successfully shot down a drone carrying illicit items destined for the Chania Correctional Facility on the afternoon of Saturday.

events.summary: Gendarmes alerted around 02:30 caught two men in flagrante delicto piloting drones to deliver parcels to Mulhouse-Lutterbach prison; Mulhouse court convicted both on 3 June 2026 to unsuspended prison terms.
events.source_title: Mulhouse : deux hommes condamnés pour livraisons par drone au CP de Lutterbach
events.quote: Le tribunal judiciaire de Mulhouse a condamné le 3 juin 2026 deux hommes
events.quote_translation: Mulhouse judicial court on 3 June 2026 convicted two men.

events.summary: Besançon police intercepted a drone delivering a small parcel on a cord to the remand prison overnight; a 28-year-old woman was arrested.
events.source_title: Besançon : un drone surpris en pleine livraison à la prison, une femme de 28 ans interpellée
events.quote: Les policiers bisontins ont surpris une livraison de colis par drone
events.quote_translation: Besançon police caught a parcel delivery by drone.

events.place: Algeciras (Cádiz) and Vitoria-Gasteiz (Álava); Strait of Gibraltar
events.summary: Operation HORUS: Policía Nacional announced eight arrests in five simultaneous searches in Algeciras and Vitoria. Group flew four-metre fixed-wing drones carrying up to 20 kg from Morocco; drugs went by hidden-compartment vehicles to Vitoria for French groups. Seized: 40 kg hashish, 2 kg cocaine, one drone, EUR 14,000.
events.payload_detail: hashish and cocaine; 40 kg hashish and 2 kg cocaine seized
events.source_title: La Policía Nacional desarticula una organización que introducía droga desde Marruecos mediante drones
events.quote: La Policía Nacional ha desarticulado una organización criminal asentada en las provincias de Cádiz y Álava
events.quote_translation: The National Police has dismantled a criminal organisation based in the provinces of Cádiz and Álava

events.place: St Brigid's Place, Portlaoise, Co. Laois
events.summary: Gardaí investigating a drone over St Brigid's Place, Portlaoise, stopped a car, arrested two men aged 36 and 43 and recovered a drone in a field; phones were reportedly found. Released, investigation ongoing.
events.payload_detail: phones reportedly found
events.source_title: Two arrested after drone seized near prison in Laois
events.quote: Gardaí arrested two men and seized a drone following a suspected attempt to fly contraband into Portlaoise Prison.
events.map_match: St Brigid's Place, Portlaoise, Co. Laois

events.summary: Police stopped a van in Salford less than a mile from HMP Manchester and found occupants and a large drone. Multiple drops that evening; one package delivered, one intercepted. Three people sentenced 17 September 2026 at Manchester Crown Court; one also charged with supply of Class A drugs.
events.payload_detail: drugs and other prohibited items; quantities not given
events.source_title: Three people jailed over drone plot to smuggle drugs into HMP Manchester
events.quote: Greater Manchester Police said that multiple drone drops had taken place at the prison that evening, and one package had been successfully delivered whilst another intercepted by prison staff.

events.summary: ESBU detectives closed a scheme in which border-village residents launched homemade drones by catapult at night to carry untaxed cigarettes to Romania; two drones, a launcher and 34 packages of cigarettes seized.
events.payload_detail: up to 12 cases per night; 34 packages seized
events.source_title: Cigarette smuggling to Romania by drone: ESBU in Bukovyna exposes smugglers' scheme
events.quote: the perpetrators managed to transport up to 12 cases of cigarettes. During the inspection of the scene, detectives seized 34 packages of cigarettes without excise tax stamps, 2 unmanned aerial vehicles, and a launcher.

events.summary: On 2 March 2026 Gardaí intercepted a drone carrying suspected drugs and phones bound for the Portlaoise prison grounds; the alleged operator was arrested and charged. On 3 March a second drone with contraband attached was found near the prison.
events.payload_detail: suspected drugs, mobile phones and other prohibited items
events.source_title: Drones delivering contraband to prison intercepted
events.quote: On Monday, they said they intercepted a drone believed to be destined for the prison grounds on the Dublin Road.

events.summary: Turnhout police intercepted two drone flights in recent weeks that tried to carry mobile phones into the prison yard. Both drones and pilots were caught. Three men aged 18, 19 and 21 were remanded by the investigating judge.
events.payload_detail: mobile phones
events.source_title: Dronepiloten betrapt die gsm's over gevangenismuur in Turnhout probeerden te smokkelen
events.quote: De politie van Turnhout heeft de afgelopen weken 2 keer dronepiloten betrapt die met hun drones gsm-toestellen tot op de binnenkoer van de gevangenis wilden brengen.
events.quote_translation: Turnhout police have in recent weeks twice caught drone pilots who tried to bring mobile phones into the prison yard with their drones.

events.summary: Carabinieri arrested/charged three Tunisian men dealing drugs in Ragusa's historic centre; among items seized was a drone with its controller, which they used to evade police checks. Also seized: scales, an axe, knuckle-dusters, a police-style flashing light.
events.source_title: Ragusa, a casa droga in grande quantità: un fermo e due arresti eseguiti dai carabinieri
events.quote: Nei guai tre tunisini operanti in centro storico e che utilizzavano pure un drone per eludere i controlli delle forze dell'ordine
events.quote_translation: Three Tunisians operating in the historic centre, who also used a drone to evade law-enforcement checks, are in trouble

events.summary: Carabinieri patrol stopped three people (aged 29, 29, 31, from Puglia) in a car near Caltanissetta prison; found a drone with accessories, 18 smartphones, about 300 g hashish, a steel-wire reel and 13,695 euro cash. Arrested for drug trafficking and illicit access to communication devices by inmates.
events.payload_detail: 18 smartphones, ~300 g hashish (cash 13,695 euro also seized)
events.source_title: Un drone per rifornire carcere con droga e cellulari: la scoperta dei carabinieri a Caltanissetta, arrestati tre giovani
events.quote: Nei giorni scorsi, i militari della Sezione Radiomobile della locale Compagnia hanno tratto in arresto tre persone
events.quote_translation: In recent days, soldiers of the local Radiomobile Section arrested three people

events.place: Campo de Gibraltar and Atlantic/Guadalquivir routes (49 searches, southern Spain)
events.summary: Police dismantled a cocaine network using narcolanchas in two phases (second phase concluded November 2025, 57 arrests, 105 total). Seizures included two hexacopter drones, 150 phones and EUR 800,000 cash. Role of the drones is not described in the article.
events.payload_detail: cocaine network; 57 tonnes linked to gang
events.source_title: Motherships, submarines and drones: Inside southern Spain’s biggest cocaine ring as leader ‘hides in Dubai’ – after 105 arrested
events.quote: In total, officers carried out 49 searches and confiscated 70 vehicles, 30 boats, six properties, three firearms, more than €800,000 in cash, two hexacopter drones, over 150 mobile phones and sophisticated maritime technology worth an estimated €2.5 million.

events.summary: Prison police at Ucciardone stopped two men flying a drone outside the prison to bring in drugs and mobile phones; seized drugs said by a union to be worth about 20,000 euro and two phones. The two were taken to Pagliarelli prison.
events.payload_detail: drugs (~20,000 euro per union), 2 phones
events.source_title: Ucciardone, cercavano di introdurre droga e cellulari con un drone: arrestati due uomini, condotti al Pagliarelli
events.quote: La Polizia Penitenziaria del carcere Ucciardone ha bloccato due uomini che, pilotando un drone all’esterno dell’istituto penitenziario, stavano tentando di far entrare all’interno sostanze stupefacenti e telefoni cellulari
events.quote_translation: Prison police at Ucciardone stopped two men who, flying a drone outside the prison, were trying to bring in drugs and mobile phones.

events.summary: Two inmates escaped Dijon remand prison's disciplinary wing after sawing cell bars with blades prosecutors believe were delivered by drone. Both later recaptured; accomplices charged.
events.payload_detail: saw blades
events.source_title: Two inmates escape French prison using drone-delivered saw blades
events.quote: Two inmates escaped from the Dijon prison detention centre's disciplinary wing early Thursday

events.summary: Border Guard found a drone with about 400 packs of cigarettes bearing Belarusian excise stamps in Krynki commune, after a resident tipped the Szudziałowo post; fire service and police called. No arrests reported.
events.payload_detail: approx 400 packs of cigarettes with Belarusian excise stamps
events.source_title: Próba przemytu dronem
events.quote: Dron wypełniony nielegalnymi papierosami ujawnili dziś funkcjonariusze Straży Granicznej w gminie Krynki. Informacja o obiekcie wpłynęła do Placówki SG w Szudziałowie od jednego z mieszkańców pogranicza.
events.quote_translation: Border Guard officers today found a drone filled with illegal cigarettes in Krynki commune. Information about the object reached the Szudziałowo SG post from a resident of the border area.

events.summary: A Prato judicial order (reported 22 Nov 2025) describes detainees managing supply of drugs, phones, knives and knuckle-dusters by drones carrying parcels, among other channels; searches on 28 June 2025 did not stop it.
events.payload_detail: drugs, phones, knives, knuckle-dusters
events.source_title: Maxi-perquisizione nel carcere di Prato: “I detenuti gestivano traffico di droga usando droni e minacciando altri carcerati”
events.quote: Alcuni detenuti gestiscono l’approvvigionamento con l’impiego di droni in grado di trasportare plichi, al cui interno viene occultato stupefacente, cellulari, coltelli e tirapugni
events.quote_translation: Some detainees manage supply using drones able to carry parcels in which drugs, phones, knives and knuckle-dusters are hidden

events.place: Brians 1 prison, Sant Esteve Sesrovires; arrest at Masquefa (Anoia)
events.summary: Mossos d'Esquadra arrested a 32-year-old man at Masquefa after a pilot detection system logged six unauthorised drone flights over Brians 1; same drone seen again 19-20 September. Parcels with hashish, cocaine and electronics were found in a yard.
events.payload_detail: hashish, cocaine and electronic material (mobile phones per article lead)
events.source_title: Detenido por entrar móviles y drogas con un dron en la cárcel de Brians 1
events.quote: los Mossos d'Esquadra han detenido a un hombre que había hecho llegar móviles y drogas a la cárcel de Brians 1 con este método.
events.quote_translation: the Mossos d'Esquadra have arrested a man who had delivered mobile phones and drugs to Brians 1 prison by this method.

events.summary: A young man from Gleizé flew 194 trips to Villefranche remand prison between 6 and 26 July; tracked home by following the drone. Sentenced to 2 years; jailed after the hearing.
events.source_title: Près de Lyon : depuis son immeuble, le pilote de drone livrait des dizaines de colis aux détenus chaque jour
events.quote: 194 voyages jusqu'à la maison d'arrêt de Villefranche entre le 6 et le 26 juillet
events.quote_translation: 194 trips to Villefranche remand prison between 6 and 26 July.

events.summary: A drone carrying a viable pipe bomb crashed into the garden of a family home in Finglas, apparently meant for a rival criminal's house, and did not detonate. Gardaí link it to a feud over the drugs trade and searched eight residences on 8 May, seizing a shotgun, ammunition, cannabis, heroin.
events.payload_detail: viable pipe bomb
events.source_title: Finglas bomb attack (RTE News, 6 May 2025; page headline not captured)
events.quote: A drone carrying the improvised explosive device, which gardaí believe was targeting a criminal's house in the area, crashed into the home of an innocent family in Glenties Park in the early hours of yesterday morning.

events.place: Clondalkin, Ballyfermot, Coolock, Tallaght (Dublin) and Mountjoy Prison cells
events.summary: Gardaí searched properties in four Dublin districts and cells in Mountjoy in an investigation into smuggling into Wheatfield, Cloverhill and Mountjoy. Seized: miniature phones packed for drone delivery, a drone, drugs, €22,000 cash, improvised weapons.
events.payload_detail: cannabis €17,000, cocaine €5,000, tablets €3,000; €22,000 cash; miniature phones
events.source_title: An Garda Síochána searches conducted as part of investigation into smuggling of controlled drugs and contraband into Irish prisons, Tuesday 8th April 2025
events.quote: During the searches of these properties, a number of miniature phones wrapped in insulation tape ready to be sent by drone to the prisons were seized.

events.summary: A large drone reportedly rated to lift 130 kg, apparently carrying a rope and harness, hovered over the Nivelles prison yard in an alleged attempt to free an inmate. No escape occurred. The drone was later found in a car in Brussels; the main suspect was remanded in custody.
events.payload_detail: rope and harness; 18.5 g hashish and one phone found on prison ground, no formal link established
events.source_title: `Drone` gigante utilizado em tentativa de fuga de prisão na Bélgica
events.quote: A tentativa de fuga aconteceu em 25 de fevereiro, quando alguns moradores da cidade ouviram um forte barulho perto da prisão
events.quote_translation: The escape attempt took place on 25 February, when some residents of the town heard a loud noise near the prison.

events.summary: Neighbourhood officers on patrol followed two men to the walls of HMP Hindley and seized a drone. Two men in their 20s arrested on suspicion of conspiracy to convey prohibited articles into prison; bailed.
events.source_title: Two men arrested after drone spotted flying at HMP Hindley
events.quote: Officers believe the suspects were trying to smuggle illegal contraband into the prison's grounds.

events.place: Piedruja parish, Krāslava municipality, border zone
events.summary: Daugavpils border guards found a drone in the border zone in Piedruja parish and, nearby, a box of contraband cigarettes wrapped in black polyethylene: 10,000 NZ Gold with Belarusian excise stamps. Drone seized; criminal proceedings opened for smuggling in a significant amount.
events.payload_detail: 10,000 NZ Gold cigarettes with Belarusian excise stamps
events.source_title: Robežsargi izņem 10 tūkstošus kontrabandas cigarešu un dronu
events.quote: Valsts robežsardzes Daugavpils pārvaldes robežsargi Piedrujas pagastā, pierobežas joslā, konstatēja bezpilota gaisa kuģi (dronu), bet teritorijas apskates laikā netālu no drona konstatēja melnā polietilēna plēvē ietītu kārbu ar kontrabandas cigaretēm.
events.quote_translation: Daugavpils border guards in Piedruja parish, in the border zone, detected an unmanned aircraft (drone) and during a survey of the area near the drone found a box of contraband cigarettes wrapped in black polyethylene film.

events.summary: A drone crashed at the Berlin juvenile prison after overflying it, carrying narcotics. A criminal complaint was filed; no suspect was identified.
events.payload_detail: Betäubungsmittel (quantity not stated)
events.source_title: Schriftliche Anfrage 19/25115: Drohnenüberflüge und Schmuggel in Berliner Justizvollzugsanstalten (Antwort)
events.quote: In dem Fall der abgestürzten Drohne in der Jugendstrafanstalt Berlin wurde eine Strafanzeige erstattet; ein Tatverdächtiger konnte nicht ermittelt werden.
events.quote_translation: In the case of the crashed drone at the Berlin juvenile prison a criminal complaint was filed; no suspect could be identified.

events.place: London prisons (Wormwood Scrubs, Brixton, Pentonville, Wandsworth, Norwich, Leicester, Onley, Bedford)
events.summary: Seven men sentenced at Harrow Crown Court for conspiracy to convey articles into prisons and to supply Class B and C drugs. Police monitoring identified over 50 drone drops in three months. Payload: drugs, phones, chargers, SIM cards.
events.payload_detail: Class B drugs, mobile phones, chargers, SIM cards
events.source_title: Drone gang behind majority of London prison drops jailed
events.quote: The group was so prolific officers believe they were responsible for the majority of drone drops in prisons across London

events.summary: After 818 kg of cocaine was dumped at sea and drifted ashore in Sejerøbugten, the group searched the coast and sea for it with a boat and a remote-controlled drone bought on 15 March 2024. Recovery failed; police seized the cocaine. Two defendants given 16 years.
events.payload_detail: 818 kg cocaine, dumped from a vessel and drifted ashore; seized by police
events.source_title: Tiltale for forsøg på overtrædelse af straffelovens § 191, ved at have forsøgt at modtage og sætte sig i besiddelse af ikke under 818 kg kokain. Påstand om frakendelse af retten til dansk indfødsret og udvisning
events.quote: retten lægger til grund, at der på Ø blev søgt efter kokainen ved kysten, og at søgningen efter kokain bl.a. skete med den drone, som var købt af Tiltalte 1
events.quote_translation: the court finds that the coast on Ø was searched for the cocaine, and that the search for cocaine was carried out, among other means, with the drone bought by Defendant 1.

events.summary: Squadra mobile and prison police arrested 13 people for delivering drugs and phones to Enna prison by drone at night, tying packages to a rope and guiding the drone to cell windows. Price list found: 2,500 euro a package, up to 3,500 for two.
events.payload_detail: 'ingenti quantitativi' of drugs and phones
events.source_title: Enna: consegnano in carcere droga e cellulari col drone, 13 arresti
events.quote: Consegnavano in volo ingenti quantitativi di droga e telefoni cellulari all’interno del carcere di Enna.
events.quote_translation: They delivered by air large quantities of drugs and mobile phones inside Enna prison.

events.summary: Chernivtsi border guards found a take-off site for an improvised aircraft at Budenets and detained two men trying to carry tobacco to Romania; aircraft carried 300 packs per flight; warning shots fired.
events.payload_detail: capacity 300 packs of cigarettes per flight
events.source_title: Border guards detained two air smugglers in Bukovina
events.quote: With the help of an airplane, a Bukovinian and a resident of Transcarpathia tried to transport tobacco products to Romania.

events.summary: Two men agreed with others to bring alpha-PVP from Russia into Estonia by quadcopter drone; on 14 April 2022 they collected a package (195.1 g substance, 154 g alpha-PVP) from a cache by the Narva border post and were stopped by police. Both convicted under plea agreements.
events.payload_detail: 195.1 g substance containing 154 g alpha-PVP
events.quote: leppis varalise kasu saamise eesmärgil kokku Venemaa Föderatsiooni territooriumilt drooni-kvadrokopteri abil Eesti Vabariigi territooriumile suures koguses narkootilise aine Alfa-PVP toimetamise
events.quote_translation: agreed, for financial gain, on delivering a large quantity of the narcotic Alpha-PVP from the territory of the Russian Federation to Estonian territory by drone-quadcopter.

events.summary: Contraband brought into PI Leeuwarden for payment by a drone, per the court's sentencing reasoning; offence proven for 2022-03-05. Defendant also convicted of drug dealing and thefts; prison sentence imposed.
events.payload_detail: 0.54 g MDMA, 10.6 g hashish, one mobile phone
events.source_title: Rechtbank Noord-Nederland, 07-10-2022, 18/075325-22
events.quote: Zo heeft hij drugs verkocht, goederen gestolen en deze via Marktplaats te koop aangeboden en heeft hij tegen betaling met een drone contrabande in de P.I. gebracht.
events.quote_translation: Thus he sold drugs, stole goods and offered them for sale on Marktplaats, and for payment he brought contraband into the prison by drone.

events.place: Slovak-Ukrainian border near Huta/Orikhovytsia (Uzhhorod district, Ukraine side)
events.summary: Ukrainian border guards found four local residents in a car with 16 drone batteries, laptop, remote controls and thermal imager near Orikhovytsia, Ukraine. Slovak border guards then detained a Slovak citizen on Slovak territory with two packages of tobacco products.
events.payload_detail: two packages of tobacco products
events.source_title: Air smuggling: Ukrainian border guards detained alleged drone operators while their Slovak colleagues detained the cigarette recipient
events.quote: Later, Slovak colleagues reported the detention of their compatriot with two packages of tobacco products on their territory.

events.summary: Contraband brought into PI Leeuwarden for payment by a drone, per the court's sentencing reasoning; offence proven for 2021-10-04. Defendant also convicted of drug dealing and thefts; prison sentence imposed.
events.payload_detail: 7.01 g MDMA, 4.74 g hashish
events.source_title: Rechtbank Noord-Nederland, 07-10-2022, 18/075325-22
events.quote: Zo heeft hij drugs verkocht, goederen gestolen en deze via Marktplaats te koop aangeboden en heeft hij tegen betaling met een drone contrabande in de P.I. gebracht.
events.quote_translation: Thus he sold drugs, stole goods and offered them for sale on Marktplaats, and for payment he brought contraband into the prison by drone.

events.summary: A detainee fired a pistol inside Frosinone prison on 9 Sept 2021; investigators identified the man who introduced the weapon into the prison by drone, part of the network later arrested in Naples (March 2024).
events.payload_detail: pistol
events.source_title: Armi, droga e telefoni in carcere con i droni, 31 arresti a Napoli
events.quote: L’attività degli investigatori riuscì a identificare l’uomo che aveva introdotto l’arma all’interno del carcere utilizzando un drone.
events.quote_translation: The investigators' work succeeded in identifying the man who had introduced the weapon into the prison using a drone.

events.summary: Kuźnica Border Guard patrol saw a drone from Belarus drop a load 900 m from the border and turn back. Three people collecting it fled by car; the Polish driver tried to ram officers. 2,000 packs of unstamped cigarettes (about PLN 30,000) seized; two Belarusians and one Pole charged.
events.payload_detail: 2,000 packs cigarettes without Polish excise stamps, nearly PLN 30,000
events.source_title: Udaremniono przemyt przy użyciu drona
events.quote: Patrol Straży Granicznej z Kuźnicy zauważył lecący obiekt z Białorusi do Polski. Ustalono, że był to bezzałogowy statek powietrzny tzw. dron, który w odległości 900 metrów od granicy państwa zrzucił ładunek i zawrócił na Białoruś.
events.quote_translation: A Border Guard patrol from Kuźnica noticed an object flying from Belarus to Poland. It was established to be an unmanned aircraft, a so-called drone, which dropped its load 900 metres from the border and turned back to Belarus.

events.place: Naples base; deliveries to 18 prisons incl. Secondigliano, Frosinone, Cosenza, Siracusa, Augusta, Catania, Rovigo, Trapani, Saluzzo, Sulmona
events.summary: Naples DDA operation: 31 people subject to two custody orders (20 + 11, Polizia di Stato and prison police). Network supplied phones, drugs and firearms to prisons by drone, paid by camorra organisations; investigation began April 2021. A 52-year-old modified drones to carry more weight.
events.payload_detail: phones, drugs, firearms (quantities not in release)
events.source_title: Armi, droga e telefoni in carcere con i droni, 31 arresti a Napoli
events.quote: Tentativo di introduzione di materiale illecito sventato
events.quote_translation: Attempt to introduce illicit material foiled

events.summary: Second of three attempts to deliver drugs into HMP Gartree, by drone, arranged between an outside associate and an inmate using a phone. Unsuccessful. Associate arrested 13 Oct 2021; sentenced 28 Jun 2024 to 5 years consecutive on the prison-conveyance count.
events.payload_detail: unquantified Class A and B drugs; attempt unsuccessful
events.source_title: R v Mohammed Jakir Hussain [2025] EWCA Crim 419
events.quote: The second attempt took place on 31 March 2021, this time involving the use of a drone. The appellant and the inmate discussed test flights and used internet searches to research the payload and how to modify the device to make less noise when being used to deliver drugs into the prison.

events.place: St John's Square near Portlaoise Prison, Co. Laois
events.summary: Gardaí seized a drone with a package of phones, chargers, crack cocaine, cocaine and cannabis (about €5,000) near Portlaoise Prison and arrested a man in his 20s. He was charged on 8 Jan 2021 and bailed on condition he not fly drones near places of detention.
events.payload_detail: mobile phones, chargers, crack cocaine, cocaine, cannabis; est. €5,000
events.source_title: Drone and drugs seized by Garda in Portlaoise 6/1/21 arrest
events.quote: Gardaí have arrested a man in his 20s following the seizure of a drone along with a package containing mobile phones, chargers and quantities of crack cocaine, cocaine and cannabis, with a combined estimated value of €5,000 (analysis pending).

events.place: Prisons in Veenhuizen, Almelo and Krimpen aan den IJssel (also other NL/BE institutions)
events.summary: Dordrecht court convicted a 34-year-old man from Rijsenhout under procedural agreements for drone drops of phones and drugs at prisons in 2021, 2023 and 2024. Drone and nearly 130 g MDMA found at his home. Two co-suspects not prosecuted.
events.payload_detail: phones and drugs; nearly 130 g MDMA at home
events.source_title: OM eist straf voor droppen telefoons en drugs bij gevangenissen
events.quote: Drones vormen in toenemende mate een serieuze bedreiging voor de orde en veiligheid in penitentiaire inrichtingen.
events.quote_translation: Drones increasingly pose a serious threat to order and security in penal institutions.

events.summary: Four prisoners were hospitalised after overdoses at Midlands Prison on Friday 18 Sept 2026, after drugs were dropped by drone into a prison yard (RTE, 20 Sept 2026, via HRB abstract).
events.payload_detail: drugs, type not stated
events.source_title: 'Number of overdose presentations' at Midlands Prison (RTE News, 20 Sep 2026, HRB mirror)
events.quote: Four prisoners were hospitalised as a result of overdoses, after drugs were dropped by drone into a prison yard.

events.place: Casa circondariale Ucciardone, Palermo (drone found on nearby balcony)
events.summary: A drone carrying drugs destined for Ucciardone was found on a balcony of a woman living near the prison, days before a 23 Sept 2026 search that found 10 phones and 350 g of drugs in cells.
events.payload_detail: drugs (type and quantity not stated)
events.source_title: Droga e dieci telefonini nelle celle dell'Ucciardone, blitz e sequestro della Polizia penitenziaria
events.quote: Nei giorni scorsi nel balcone di una donna che vive nei pressi del carcere borbonico è stato trovato un drone nel balcone che trasportava droga che era destinata all’interno del carcere Ucciardone.
events.quote_translation: In recent days a drone carrying drugs destined for Ucciardone prison was found on the balcony of a woman living near the Bourbon-era prison.

events.summary: A drone attempted to introduce prohibited items into Larissa Prison; the Tevkros anti-drone system neutralised it. Items carried are not described in the source.
events.source_title: Drone Delivering Drugs Eliminated Over Greek Prison
events.quote: authorities activated one of the systems at the Larissa Prison on Thursday, August 20, after a drone attempted to introduce prohibited items into the correctional facility.

events.summary: A drone evaded counter-measures and delivered a load near a cell at Poggioreale; searches found about 600 g hashish, then 400 g in another cell, a total of about 1 kg. Prison police union says drones also deliver phones.
events.payload_detail: approx 1 kg hashish (600 g + 400 g)
events.source_title: Nel carcere di Napoli il corriere della droga è un drone
events.quote: Complessivamente è stato quindi sequestrato un chilo di hashish che era entrato nel penitenziario attraverso il drone.
events.quote_translation: In total a kilo of hashish that had entered the prison by drone was therefore seized.

events.summary: Border guards at Purvėnai post took control of a small home-made drone that flew from the Belarus border inland, found about 500 m from the border with two cartons of Queen Menthol cigarettes (EUR 5,460). Administrative proceedings opened.
events.payload_detail: two standard cartons Queen Menthol cigarettes, EUR 5,460 incl. taxes
events.source_title: Pasieniečiai Šalčininkų rajone perėmė kontrabandininkų skraidyklę su rūkalais
events.quote: Purvėnų užkardos pasieniečiai Šalčininkų rajone perėmė bepiločio orlaivio valdymą ir jį nutupdė, ketvirtadienį pranešė Valstybės sienos apsaugos tarnyba (VSAT).
events.quote_translation: Purvėnai post border guards in Šalčininkai district took control of the unmanned aircraft and landed it, the State Border Guard Service (VSAT) reported on Thursday.

events.summary: A drone crashed in daylight against Tahíche prison on Lanzarote. Prison unions ACAIP and UGT said it was the first drone seen at the prison and that such drones usually carry drugs and phones. Institutional sources had not confirmed its purpose.
events.source_title: A drone crashes in broad daylight against the Tahíche prison: they use it to introduce drugs
events.quote: For the moment, institutional sources have not confirmed whether it was used for these purposes this time.

events.summary: Prison police foiled another attempt at Caltagirone prison (block 200) to introduce drugs and phones; the people involved rammed the officers' car and escaped. Headline refers to a drone.
events.payload_detail: not itemised in text seen
events.source_title: Droga e cellulari in carcere con un drone
events.quote: l’ennesimo tentativo di introdurre materiale vietato
events.quote_translation: the umpteenth attempt to introduce prohibited material

events.place: Jaskonys village area near Druskininkai, Belarus border
events.summary: Druskininkai border guards used anti-drone equipment to bring down four drones flying in from Belarus. They carried 4,998 packs of Belarusian cigarettes worth over EUR 27,500. Pre-trial investigation opened by Varena border unit under Kaunas regional prosecutor.
events.payload_detail: 4,998 packs of Belarusian-stamped cigarettes, over EUR 27,500 incl. taxes
events.source_title: VSAT: Druskininkų pasieniečiai nutupdė keturis iš Baltarusijos įskridusius dronus
events.quote: Druskininkų pasieniečiai naktį vienu kartu nutupdė keturis iš Baltarusijos įskridusius dronus su nelegalių rūkalų kroviniais. Iš viso buvo gabenama 5 tūkst. pakelių baltarusiškų cigarečių, pranešė Valstybės sienos apsaugos tarnyba (VSAT).
events.quote_translation: Druskininkai border guards at night landed four drones flying in from Belarus with illegal cigarette loads in one go. In total about 5,000 packs of Belarusian cigarettes were being carried, the State Border Guard Service (VSAT) reported.

events.summary: Border guards used counter-drone equipment to bring down a drone flying from the Belarus border inland in Šalčininkai district. Its bundle held 200 packs of NZ Gold cigarettes with Belarusian stamps worth EUR 1,102. Administrative proceedings opened at Purvėnai post.
events.payload_detail: 200 packs NZ Gold cigarettes, EUR 1,102 incl. taxes
events.source_title: Sekmadienį VSAT pareigūnai nutupdė kontrabandines cigaretes skraidinusį droną
events.quote: Sekmadienį pasieniečiai Šalčininkų rajone perėmė bepilotį orlaivį, gabenusį kontrabandą – 200 pakelių cigarečių, praneša Valstybės sienos apsaugos tarnyba (VSAT).
events.quote_translation: On Sunday border guards in Šalčininkai district intercepted an unmanned aircraft carrying contraband, 200 packs of cigarettes, the State Border Guard Service (VSAT) reports.

events.place: Sanlúcar de Barrameda (Cádiz), rooftop on seafront
events.summary: El Debate reporters filming in Sanlúcar de Barrameda were watched with thermal cameras and drones operated from the roof of the tallest seafront building, which interrupted an interview. The outlet says authorities describe this as frequent practice by drug traffickers.
events.source_title: En vídeo | Así acosaron los narcos a los reporteros de El Debate: chivatazos, drones y fotos por WhatsApp
events.quote: Según comentan las autoridades, es un recurso frecuentemente utilizado por los narcotraficantes, que controlan todo el paisaje desde la azotea de un alto edificio situado en primera línea de playa.
events.quote_translation: According to the authorities, it is a resource frequently used by drug traffickers, who control the whole landscape from the roof of a tall building on the seafront.

events.place: Alhaurín de la Torre prison, Málaga
events.summary: Prison staff found a small remote-controlled aircraft that had dropped over 1 kg of hashish inside the grounds; the drone was located in an inmate's cell. The inmate was questioned and a report sent to the duty court. The person flying it had not been identified.
events.payload_detail: more than 1 kg hashish
events.source_title: Manhunt after drone caught dropping 1kg of drugs into Alhaurin de la Torre prison
events.quote: The operation took place at Alhaurin de la Torre prison, where staff discovered a small remote-controlled aircraft that had allegedly been used to deliver the drugs to an inmate.
events.map_match: Alhaurín de la Torre prison, Málaga

events.summary: Police patrol at about 00:40 found two men and a woman with a flight-ready drone near the prison, carrying a package with mobile phones and a suspected drug-soaked paper. Drone and contraband seized.
events.payload_detail: package with mobile phones and a 'drogenverdächtiges Papier'
events.source_title: Gefängnis Neuruppin-Wulkow: Polizei stoppt Drogenschmuggel per Drohne
events.quote: Eine Streife entdeckte gegen 00:40 Uhr in der Nähe des Gefängnisses zwei Männer und eine Frau mit einer flugbereiten Drohne, wie ein Sprecher der Polizei sagte.
events.quote_translation: A patrol spotted two men and a woman with a flight-ready drone near the prison at about 00:40, a police spokesperson said.

events.summary: Prison police foiled four attempts within a few days to introduce drugs into Caltagirone prison via drones, postal parcels and throws from outside; about 1 kg of drugs and several phones intercepted.
events.payload_detail: ~1 kg drugs, several phones
events.source_title: Droni, droga e cellulari: sventati quattro “lanci” all’interno del carcere
events.quote: quattro tentativi di introduzione di droga in carcere
events.quote_translation: four attempts to introduce drugs into prison

events.summary: Around 20:00 prison police detected a drone over the detention area trying to release a package from outside the perimeter; the drone was not downed but the load was recovered.
events.payload_detail: package contents not stated in the text seen
events.source_title: Drone con droga e cellulari nel carcere: la Polizia Penitenziaria sventa il traffico illecito
events.quote: Tentativo di introduzione di materiale illecito sventato
events.quote_translation: Attempt to introduce illicit material foiled

events.summary: Carabinieri seized a drone with a nylon line holding a bag of three smartphones, 200 g hashish and about 4 g crack, destined for Poggioreale inmates. Found in the area around the prison next to the Centro Direzionale.
events.payload_detail: 3 smartphones, 200 g hashish, ~4 g crack
events.source_title: Sequestrato a Napoli drone con telefoni e droga, business hi-tech dei clan
events.quote: Un drone con un filo di nylon al quale era legata una busta contenente tre smartphone, 200 grammi di hashish e circa 4 di crack, destinato ai detenuti del carcere di Poggioreale è stato sequestrato dai Carabinieri a Napoli.
events.quote_translation: A drone with a nylon line tied to a bag holding three smartphones, 200 grams of hashish and about 4 of crack, meant for inmates of Poggioreale prison, was seized by Carabinieri in Naples.

events.place: General Detention Facility of Trikala, Trikala
events.summary: Between 02:30 and 03:30 guards saw a drone over the prison perimeter that tried to drop a package of mobile phones and accessories into the yard; anti-drone systems downed it in a nearby field.
events.payload_detail: mobile phones and communication accessories
events.source_title: Πτήση drone πάνω από τις φυλακές Τρικάλων - Φρουροί κατάφεραν να το καταρρίψουν
events.quote: επιχείρησαν να ρίψουν δέμα που περιείχε κινητά τηλέφωνα και αξεσουάρ επικοινωνίας στον προαύλιο χώρο, με προορισμό την πτέρυγα των κρατούμενων.
events.quote_translation: they attempted to drop a package containing mobile phones and communication accessories in the yard, destined for the prisoners' wing.

events.summary: A drone came down in the prison yard and an inmate collected the attached package before staff noticed. Cell searches seized two phones and two SIM cards; four charging cables were recovered with the drone.
events.payload_detail: 2 phones, 2 SIM cards, 4 charging cables
events.source_title: ΕΛ.ΑΣ.: Eπιχείρησαν να περάσουν με drones απαγορευμένα αντικείμενα στις φυλακές Δράμας και Λάρισας
events.quote: το πρωί της Κυριακής 1 Μαρτίου, μη επανδρωμένο αεροσκάφος (drone) κατέπεσε σε προαύλιο του Σωφρονιστικού Καταστήματος Λάρισας, ενώ κρατούμενος, ο οποίος έγινε αντιληπτός από υπάλληλο των φυλακών, παρέλαβε προσκολλημένο σε αυτό δέμα.
events.quote_translation: on the morning of Sunday 1 March, a drone crashed in the yard of Larissa Correctional Facility, while a prisoner, noticed by a prison employee, took the package attached to it.

events.summary: A guard saw a drone approach the prison during inmate yard time; the anti-drone jammer brought it down inside the perimeter. Its package held five phones, six SIM cards, a multi-tool knife, earphones, charging cables and three light bulbs.
events.payload_detail: 5 phones, 6 SIM cards, multi-tool knife, earphones, cables
events.source_title: ΕΛ.ΑΣ.: Eπιχείρησαν να περάσουν με drones απαγορευμένα αντικείμενα στις φυλακές Δράμας και Λάρισας
events.quote: Αποτράπηκαν δύο περιπτώσεις εισαγωγής απαγορευμένων αντικειμένων μέσω drone στα Σωφρονιστικά Καταστήματα Δράμας και Λάρισας το Σαββατοκύριακο 28 Φεβρουαρίου και 1 Μαρτίου 2026.
events.quote_translation: Two cases of introducing prohibited items by drone were prevented at the Drama and Larissa correctional facilities on the weekend of 28 February and 1 March 2026.

events.summary: Olbia prosecutor Sara Martino requested pre-trial custody for four people (including a woman from Messina) accused of belonging to an association that used sophisticated drones to bring drugs and phones to inmates in Sardinian prisons.
events.source_title: Droni per introdurre droga e cellulari nelle carceri sarde: quattro arresti a Olbia, tra loro anche una donna di Messina
events.quote: Sono accusati di far parte di un'associazione che, con droni sofisticati facevano arrivare ai detenuto le desiderata
events.quote_translation: They are accused of belonging to an association that, with sophisticated drones, delivered inmates what they wanted

events.summary: Guardia Civil Pegaso team jammed a drone in flight heading for Ceuta prison. The drone was found and seized carrying narcotics and two micro mobile phones. Case handled by the 1st Fiscal Company. Exact flight date not given; 2026-01-16 is the article date.
events.payload_detail: narcotics (hashish per headline lead) and two micro mobile phones
events.source_title: La Guardia Civil inhibe un dron que llevaba droga y micro-teléfonos a la cárcel
events.quote: Tras ello, el dron fue localizado e incautado, comprobado que llevaba sustancias estupefacientes y dos micro-teléfonos móviles
events.quote_translation: After that, the drone was located and seized, and found to be carrying narcotics and two micro mobile phones.

events.place: Sevilla I prison, Alcalá de Guadaíra
events.summary: A drone flew to the cell windows of Sevilla I and released a bag that fell in a module yard, where a person collected it. Video was posted on social media. Reported about a week before 16 October 2025.
events.source_title: Interior gastará cuatro millones de euros para proteger las prisiones españolas de los asaltos de drones
events.quote: El dron desprendió una bolsa que cayó al patio de unos de los módulos. Una sombra estaba esperando el paquete y se lo llevó.
events.quote_translation: The drone released a bag that fell in the yard of one of the modules. A shadow was waiting for the package and took it.

events.summary: Drone carrying a large parcel found in the grounds of HMP Berwyn; parcel contained mobile phones, chargers and herbal drugs. Police seized drone and parcel. No arrests reported. Two vehicles burned in staff car park on 29 September, link not stated.
events.payload_detail: mobile phones, chargers, herbal drugs
events.source_title: Drone carrying contraband seized at HMP Berwyn grounds
events.quote: The parcel was x-rayed and was found to contain a quantity of mobile phones, chargers, and herbal drugs.

events.summary: Prison sources and the guards' union reported drones overflying Lisbon prison for two consecutive weeks. A parcel with high-end phones, chargers and memory cards dropped by a drone was recovered in the early hours of Friday 12 September.
events.payload_detail: high-end phones, chargers and memory cards
events.source_title: Drones sobrevoam prisão de Lisboa há duas semanas e deixam embrulho
events.quote: Há duas semanas consecutivas que o Estabelecimento Prisional de Lisboa (EPL) é sobrevoado por drones, que depois desaparecem sem deixar rasto.
events.quote_translation: For two consecutive weeks Lisbon Prison (EPL) has been overflown by drones, which then disappear without trace.

events.summary: Prison officers seized two drone-dropped packages on 6 and 10 Sept 2025 containing tablets, heroin, fob phones and chargers. A prison source says drones burn through yard netting and then drop packages.
events.payload_detail: tablets, heroin, fob phones, chargers; 'thousands of euros'
events.source_title: Exclusive: Drones used to burn Limerick Prison yard netting for drug drops
events.quote: Prison officers seized packages on September 6 and 10 before they could get into criminals’ hands.

events.summary: PSP stopped a man placing phones, chargers and drugs into Lisbon prison by drone in the early hours of Thursday. The aircraft was painted black and flew without lights. The operator escaped the officers.
events.payload_detail: phones, chargers and drugs
events.source_title: PSP impede tráfico de telemóveis e droga por drone na cadeia de Lisboa
events.quote: A PSP impediu um homem de colocar artigos ilegais (telemóveis, carregadores e droga) a partir de um drone, na madrugada de quinta-feira, no interior da prisão de Lisboa.
events.quote_translation: The PSP stopped a man from placing illegal items (phones, chargers and drugs) from a drone, in the early hours of Thursday, inside Lisbon prison.

events.summary: Member of parliament states the prison was overflown 23 times by drones overnight 19-20 August 2025. Claim made in a written parliamentary question, not an official count.
events.source_title: Question écrite n° 9618 : Installation de filets dans les prisons pour lutter contre les drones
events.quote: dans la nuit du 19 au 20 août 2025, la prison de Varennes-le-Grand a été survolée 23 fois par des drones
events.quote_translation: in the night of 19 to 20 August 2025, Varennes-le-Grand prison was overflown 23 times by drones.

events.summary: Police special-purpose officers found a drone that fell into the Mostar prison yard with a mobile phone, a USB cable and several bags of a suspected drug glued to its body, and stopped the operator retrieving it; operator unidentified.
events.payload_detail: phone, USB cable, bags of suspected drugs (quantity not stated)
events.source_title: Zatvorenik dronom naručio mobitel i drogu, letjelica s paketićima pala u zatvorsko dvorište
events.quote: Pripadnici policije spriječili su u nedjelju navečer gotovo filmski pokušaj krijumčarenja narkotika i mobitela dronom u zatvor u Mostaru, izvijestilo je u ponedjeljak Ministarstvo unutarnjih poslova Hercegovačko-neretvanske županije.
events.quote_translation: Police on Sunday evening prevented an almost cinematic attempt to smuggle narcotics and a mobile phone by drone into the prison in Mostar, the Interior Ministry of Herzegovina-Neretva Canton reported on Monday.

events.summary: Security guards at Mas d'Enric prison saw lights of drones, possibly up to six, over the restricted airspace of the prison during the second half of a football match on the evening of Saturday 3 May 2025. No delivery or arrest reported.
events.source_title: Alerta en la cárcel de Tarragona por la presencia de drones ilegales en su espacio aéreo
events.quote: los guardias de seguridad de la cárcel de Tarragona advirtieron que, sobre el espacio aéreo del centro penitenciario
events.quote_translation: the security guards of Tarragona prison noticed that, over the airspace of the prison

events.summary: Prison police intercepted a drone over the detention areas of Foggia prison on the evening of 10 March 2025 and recovered a package of about 500 g hashish and cocaine, SIM cards and other prohibited items. The drone was downed with a jammer rifle.
events.payload_detail: ~500 g hashish and cocaine, SIM cards, other items
events.source_title: Droni Illegali sulle Carceri italiane: due successi per le autorità (e forse qualcosa sta cambiando)
events.quote: l’intervento, avvenuto nella serata del 10 marzo 2025, è stato reso possibile grazie alla prontezza degli agenti, che sono riusciti a intercettare il velivolo mentre sorvolava gli spazi detentivi e a recuperarne il carico
events.quote_translation: the operation, on the evening of 10 March 2025, was made possible by the officers' readiness, who intercepted the aircraft while it flew over the detention areas and recovered its load

events.summary: Staff at Wheatfield Prison intercepted a drone delivery and seized a large quantity of contraband, including drugs and mobile phones, per an Irish Prison Service social media post reported on 16 Mar 2025. No arrests stated.
events.payload_detail: 'a large quantity of contraband'; drugs and mobile phones pictured
events.source_title: Drone 'intercepted' delivering 'large quantity' of drugs and mobile phones to Irish prison
events.quote: Earlier today staff at Wheatfield Prison intercepted a drone delivery into the prison that resulted in the seizure of a large quantity of contraband

events.summary: After prison officers noticed movement around Taranto prison, the Questura's Squadra mobile found in thick vegetation a few hundred metres from the perimeter a medium drone with a fishing-line-tied packet: four hashish blocks (~100 g), three marijuana doses, ~4 g cocaine and a smartphone with earphones and SIM.
events.payload_detail: ~100 g hashish, 3 doses marijuana, ~4 g cocaine, smartphone + SIM
events.source_title: Droni Illegali sulle Carceri italiane: due successi per le autorità (e forse qualcosa sta cambiando)
events.quote: recuperato e sequestrato un drone di medie dimensioni al quale era stato legato con una lenza un piccolo pacchetto di plastica con all’interno quattro panetti di hashish per un peso complessivo di circa cento grammi
events.quote_translation: recovered and seized a medium-sized drone to which a small plastic packet had been tied with a fishing line, containing four hashish blocks weighing about one hundred grams in total

events.summary: State Police saw a drone with a small package heading for the prison territory at about 15:00 in daylight and brought it down by taking control. Two pilots, over 500 m away, were found and fined about EUR 2,000 administratively because delivery failed. Police linked them to the criminal world.
events.payload_detail: small package for inmates; contents not stated
events.source_title: Pārtver drona veiktu piegādi Rīgas centrālcietumam
events.quote: Gaišā dienas laikā, ap pulksten 15 likumsargi pamanīja dronu, kas virzījās uz Rīgas centrālcietuma teritoriju. Bija redzams, ka pie drona piestiprināta neliela paciņa.
events.quote_translation: In daylight, at about 15:00, law enforcers noticed a drone heading toward the Riga Central Prison territory. A small package was visibly attached to the drone.

events.place: Messina (drone fell in Gazzetta del Sud premises; suspected target Gazzi prison)
events.summary: A drone lost orientation and fell into the Gazzetta del Sud garden in Messina at night (Tue-Wed before 2 Feb 2025), still carrying on a fishing line a packet with two analogue phones, about 100 g hashish and 20 g cocaine. Suspected destined for an inmate at Gazzi prison.
events.payload_detail: 2 analogue phones, ~100 g hashish, 20 g cocaine
events.source_title: Droga e telefonini nelle celle, indagini sulla rete dei contatti (Gazzetta del Sud, 2 Feb 2025; clipping PDF)
events.quote: La notte tra martedì e mercoledì il clamoroso ritrovamento di un drone che, perso l’orientamento, è caduto nel giardino interno dello stabilimento di Gazzetta del Sud.
events.quote_translation: On the night between Tuesday and Wednesday, the striking discovery of a drone that, having lost its bearings, fell into the inner garden of the Gazzetta del Sud plant.

events.place: Algeciras and Marbella (Campo de Gibraltar and Costa del Sol)
events.summary: Policía Nacional dismantled a network introducing hashish from Morocco with large home-built drones made in Ukraine, about 10 kg per flight, range over 50 km. Ten arrested, seven jailed, six searches in Algeciras and Marbella; three aircraft seized. Europol, Ukraine and Poland assisted.
events.payload_detail: hashish, about 10 kg per flight; one group tried to send up to 1,000 kg
events.source_title: La Policía Nacional desmantela una red de “narcodrones” que operaba entre España y Marruecos
events.quote: Agentes de la Policía Nacional han desarticulado en Algeciras una organización criminal dedicada, presuntamente, a la introducción de hachís en nuestro país procedente de Marruecos utilizando aeronaves no tripuladas.
events.quote_translation: National Police officers have broken up in Algeciras a criminal organisation allegedly dedicated to bringing hashish into Spain from Morocco using unmanned aircraft.

events.summary: Guardia di Finanza GICO of Caltanissetta and Catania arrested two Italians near Caltanissetta prison who intended to use a drone to deliver a backpack of drugs and phones: 10 micro-phones, 2 smartphones, 12 SIM cards, 100 g marijuana, over 150 g hashish. A professional drone and 5,000 euro (pilot's fee) were found in the car.
events.payload_detail: 10 micro-phones, 2 smartphones, 12 SIMs, 100 g marijuana, >150 g hashish
events.source_title: Un drone per portare in carcere telefoni e droga: due arresti
events.quote: ha portato i finanzieri dei GICO di Caltanissetta e Catania, ad individuare e, successivamente, ad arrestare due soggetti di nazionalità italiana che, nei pressi della Casa Circondariale di Caltanissetta, intendevano utilizzare un drone
events.quote_translation: led GdF GICO officers of Caltanissetta and Catania to identify and then arrest two Italians who, near the Caltanissetta prison, intended to use a drone

events.place: HMP Winchester and other prisons in England, Scotland and Wales
events.summary: Kaine Jones, 28, sentenced to six years at Redditch Crown Court for conspiracy to convey prohibited articles into prisons and possession of MDMA with intent to supply. A large drone was found in a van in June 2024; a modified drone crashed at HMP Winchester in August 2024.
events.payload_detail: phones, tobacco, cannabis, MDMA, iPhones, SIM cards
events.source_title: Redditch man who lead prison drone drug drop jailed for six years
events.quote: Their efforts have significantly disrupted the ingress of illicit items into prisons across England, Scotland and Wales.

events.summary: Police arrested two men in their twenties in a central Brussels building and found a hook-equipped drone, a catapult and six packed parcels marked with nicknames, intended for prisoners. Parcels held phones, some also drugs. A firearm and cannabis resin, cocaine and cash were also found. Both were remanded.
events.payload_detail: parcels with one or more mobile phones, some also narcotics (7 phones per Brussels Times)
events.source_title: Arrestation de deux dealers suspectés de livrer des colis à des personnes emprisonnées
events.quote: un drone téléguidé doté d’un crochet, une catapulte et six colis soigneusement empaquetés pour supporter les chocs, chacun distinguable par l’annotation d’un surnom
events.quote_translation: a remote-controlled drone fitted with a hook, a catapult and six parcels carefully packed to withstand shocks, each marked with a nickname

events.summary: Gang whose scouts used heat-seeking-camera drones to find cannabis grows were caught at a Mansfield house with a knife and 250+ plants. Six men sentenced at Nottingham Crown Court for conspiracy to commit robbery, 2y4m to 5 years.
events.source_title: Gang used drone to find and then steal cannabis grows
events.quote: Analysis of seized mobile phones showed "scouts" used drones with heat-seeking cameras to find grows, then teams were assembled in London to take the crop.

events.place: Gela (Caltanissetta); drone deliveries to prisons incl. Agrigento, Messina, Ancona
events.summary: Operation 'The Wall': Carabinieri executed custody orders on 15 people (Caltanissetta court, DDA request) over drug trafficking and weapons, aggravated by aiding the Rinzivillo mafia family. Offences May 2024 to June 2025; the network used drones to bring drugs and phones into prisons.
events.payload_detail: hashish, cocaine, some crack; phones
events.source_title: Mafia e droga, telefonini nelle carceri coi droni, 15 arresti
events.quote: L'organizzazione utilizzava droni per portare nelle carceri droga e telefonini.
events.quote_translation: The organisation used drones to bring drugs and phones into prisons.

events.place: forest area, Kovel district, Volyn Oblast
events.summary: Border guards detained three men from Turiisk area in woodland as they prepared a catapult-launched fixed-wing drone to carry 360 packs of cigarettes to Poland; two who fled were tracked by a border-guard drone. Drone, laptop, batteries, catapult, cigarettes and car handed to ESBU.
events.payload_detail: 360 packs of cigarettes
events.source_title: Переправляли цигарки безпілотником: затримали трьох жителів Турійщини
events.quote: У ніч на 15 квітня у Ковельському районі під час спроби переправлення цигарок за кордон затримали трьох чоловіків та вилучили у них безпілотник
events.quote_translation: On the night of 15 April in Kovel district, three men were detained during an attempt to move cigarettes across the border and a drone was seized from them.

events.place: Justitieel Complex Zaanstad; prisons in Lelystad and Veenhuizen
events.summary: Police arrested three men aged 25-32 (Rijsenhout, Amsterdam, Schiedam) suspected of delivering drugs and phones by drone to prisoners on order since 2021. Drones, drugs and drone parts found at homes.
events.payload_detail: drugs and mobile phones; weapons also mentioned by NH Nieuws
events.source_title: Arrestaties voor leveren drugs en telefoons met drones in gevangenissen
events.quote: De politie heeft drie mannen opgepakt die met behulp van drones op bestelling spullen afleverden aan gedetineerden.
events.quote_translation: The police have arrested three men who used drones to deliver items to inmates on order.

events.summary: Gardaí were told on 12 Feb 2024 of a drone over Cloverhill Prison, found it on adjacent waste land, and intercepted two men, one holding the controller. The drone carried a copper pipe with 5 deals of heroin worth €587. Karl Widdess, who supplied the drone and stored €181,995, received a fully suspended 3-year sentence on 25 Jul 2025.
events.payload_detail: 5 deals of heroin, €587
events.source_title: Grandfather avoids jail over attempted prison drone drug delivery
events.quote: gardaí were notified on 12 February 2024 that there was a drone flying over Cloverhill prison. The drone tracking system within the prison was able to tell where the drone had originated from.

events.place: outskirts of a border town, Kovel district, Volyn Oblast
events.summary: Border guards with the SSU brought down a quadcopter carrying two packages of 22.5 kg hashish in Kovel district; three Volyn residents given notice of suspicion and remanded; drone, drugs and three vehicles seized.
events.payload_detail: 22.5 kg hashish
events.source_title: Over 22 kilograms of drugs worth 13 million hryvnias. Border guards in Volyn intercepted a drone carrying hashish
events.quote: successfully brought down a quadcopter carrying two packages. Subsequent investigation revealed that the packages contained 22.5 kilograms of hashish.

events.summary: Bordeaux authorities reportedly held three people suspected of flying drones carrying cannabis, ecstasy, cocaine, phones and alcohol to Gradignan and other regional prisons; pilot aged 17, brother of an inmate.
events.source_title: France busts a family drone ring running drugs into several prisons
events.quote: the illegal aerial delivery operation turned out to be something of a family affair as well.

events.summary: Oliver Onyeahasi, 26, of Bristol sentenced to 40 months for a low-flying drone delivery of Class A, B and C drugs within HMP Erlestoke grounds on 1 October 2023. Drone, package and discarded controller recovered.
events.payload_detail: Class A, B and C drugs
events.source_title: Man who attempted to deliver drugs into prison using drone jailed
events.quote: Those using drones to smuggle contraband into our prisons will feel the full force of the law.

events.summary: Gendarmerie dismantled 'Air Colis', a drone delivery ring supplying prisons in western France; four arrested, nine DJI drones seized; orders confirmed via Snapchat; €400 per delivery.
events.source_title: French police bust startup 'Air Colis' drone deliveries to prisons
events.quote: a Snapchat-based method of confirming orders emanating from inside the clink.

events.place: northern border sector, ITPF Sighetu Marmației
events.summary: Sighetu Marmației border police reported 2,960 packs of Ukrainian cigarettes seized in targeted actions; in one case three small parcels were flown over the border by drone to be collected by a Ukrainian citizen.
events.payload_detail: three small parcels; 2,960 packs total seized in the actions
events.source_title: Contrabandă cu drona la frontiera de nord
events.quote: Într-unul din cazuri, ţigările de contrabandă, ambalate în trei colete de mici dimensiuni, au fost trecute peste frontieră cu o dronă şi urmau a fi preluate de un cetăţean ucrainean.
events.quote_translation: In one of the cases, the contraband cigarettes, packed in three small parcels, were carried across the border by a drone and were to be collected by a Ukrainian citizen.

events.summary: Carabinieri searches in a DDA Naples inquiry into the Ligato clan found two professional drones (over 5,000 euro, one thermal-camera) at the homes of a boss's son and an associate. A victim of extortion says the son used a drone to send warnings after he stopped paying.
events.source_title: Telecamere termiche e droni della camorra sequestrati a Caserta. L'ipotesi: usati per controllare il territorio
events.quote: due droni professionali del valore di oltre cinquemila euro, di cui uno con telecamera termica per uso notturno
events.quote_translation: two professional drones worth over five thousand euro, one with a thermal camera for night use

events.summary: National Administration of Penitentiaries director said drones tried to deliver drugs and phones at this prison in 2023; at least one case; the drone was not downed, the user was detained and a criminal file opened.
events.source_title: Droguri și telefoane aduse cu drona în închisorile din România
events.quote: S-a întâmplat anul trecut, în penitenciarele din Arad și Rahova. Informațiile au fost confirmate de directorul general al Administrației Naționale a Penitenciarelor, Dan Halchin, la Euronews România
events.quote_translation: It happened last year, in the Arad and Rahova penitentiaries. The information was confirmed by the director general of the National Administration of Penitentiaries, Dan Halchin, on Euronews Romania.

events.summary: At about 03:50 a drone flew into a prison yard carrying a small bag on a string towards a cell window, was pulled by inmates, hit the wall and crashed. Drone seized; a phone and five SIM cards were found in a cell. Appeal concerned a search warrant for a suspect's home.
events.payload_detail: mobile phone and five SIM cards seized in the cell searched after the crash
events.source_title: 5/23.3JASTB-A.E1
events.quote: no dia 31/12/2022, cerca das 03h.50m., o drone de marca "…", com a placa identificativa "… sobrevou o pátio do campo da bola do Estabelecimento Prisional …, desceu e entrou no mesmo, com um pequeno saco branco pendurado por um fio, aproximando-se imediatamente da janela da cela
events.quote_translation: on 31/12/2022, at about 03:50, the drone of make '…', with identification plate '…', flew over the football-pitch yard of Prison …, descended and entered it with a small white bag hanging from a string, approaching the cell window immediately.

events.place: outskirts of Ternava village, Lviv Oblast (10 km from the border)
events.summary: Border guards saw men trying to launch four homemade drones carrying 3,600 packs of cigarettes toward Poland; the men fled. Drones flew over 10 km into Poland, where Polish guards found the parcels and detained a man who came to collect.
events.payload_detail: 3,600 packs unstamped cigarettes; SUV with trailer, launch kit, 4,000 zloty seized
events.source_title: Переправляли сигарети до Польщі безпілотниками. На Львівщині викрили незаконну схему
events.quote: Вночі, 7 вересня, прикордонники помітили чоловіків, які намагались переправити сигарети до Польщі за допомогою чотирьох безпілотників.
events.quote_translation: On the night of 7 September, border guards noticed men trying to move cigarettes to Poland with four drones.

events.summary: Bieszczady Border Guard heard a drone late on 6 September 2022, located boxes dropped nearby, and detained a 39-year-old Polish man loading six packages (over 1,000 packs of cigarettes, over PLN 15,000) into his car. He was charged with smuggling from Ukraine and confessed.
events.payload_detail: over 1,000 packs of cigarettes, over PLN 15,000
events.source_title: Papierosy spadły… z nieba. Przemytnicy wykorzystali drony
events.quote: Mundurowi zatrzymali Polaka zbierającego pakunki wypełnione nielegalnymi papierosami, które do Polski zostały przerzucone dronem.
events.quote_translation: Officers detained a Pole collecting packages filled with illegal cigarettes that had been thrown into Poland by drone.

events.place: HMP Onley, Rugby, and 10 other prisons and young offender institutions
events.summary: A husband-and-wife pair flew drugs, phones, SIM cards and tobacco into 11 prisons on 78 dates (at least 72 at HMP Onley); over 100 incursions. Police say about 50,000 GBP paid to the pilot was laundered through the wife's account. Jailed for more than seven years combined.
events.payload_detail: heroin, cocaine, cannabis, steroids, tobacco, phones, SIM cards, chargers
events.source_title: Smugglers used drone to drop thousands of pounds worth of drugs and contraband into prison near Rugby
events.quote: Maranay used her bank account to launder nearly £50,000, which her husband had been paid for piloting the drones and delivering the contraband at pre-arranged drop points.
events.linked_case_note: Investigation led by Northamptonshire Police; distinct from the 2021 HMP Onley item a518ec6396.

events.place: Castellar de la Frontera (Cádiz); arrests in Cádiz, Málaga and Ceuta
events.summary: Policía Nacional dismantled a group building home-made underwater drones at Castellar de la Frontera, able to carry up to 200 kg across the Strait; three underwater drones, six multi-motor aerial drones, 145 kg hashish and EUR 157,370 seized. Eight arrested, six jailed. First Policía Nacional seizure of underwater drones.
events.payload_detail: 145 kg hashish and 8 kg marijuana seized; underwater drones built for 150-200 kg loads
events.source_title: La 'fábrica' de drones submarinos capaces de atravesar El Estrecho con 200 kilos de droga
events.quote: En Castelar de la Frontera, un municipio gaditano de poco más de 3.000 habitantes en la comarca de Campo de Gibraltar, una organización se dedicaba a construir de manera artesanal drones submarinos capaces de cruzar el Estrecho con una carga de hasta 200 kilos de estupefacientes a bordo.
events.quote_translation: In Castellar de la Frontera, a Cádiz town of just over 3,000 people in the Campo de Gibraltar, an organisation built home-made underwater drones able to cross the Strait carrying up to 200 kilos of narcotics.

events.place: Porumbești area, Halmeu sector, Satu Mare County (2 km from the border)
events.summary: Halmeu border police saw a small aircraft (drone) carrying a parcel at 23:00 and found two people 2 km from the border loading a black-foil parcel into a car; about 500 packs of cigarettes seized; two Romanian citizens under investigation for smuggling.
events.payload_detail: approx 500 packs of cigarettes
events.source_title: Țigări de contrabandă transportate cu drona
events.quote: În data de 19 februarie a.c., în jurul orei 23.00, polițiștii de frontieră din cadrul Sectorului P.F. Halemu – județul Satu Mare, aflați în misiune de supraveghere a frontierei de stat, au observat, pe direcția localitpții Porumbești, un aparat de zbor de mici dimensiuni (dronă), care transporta un colet.
events.quote_translation: On 19 February, around 23:00, border police of Halmeu sector, Satu Mare county, on border surveillance duty, observed in the direction of Porumbești a small aircraft (drone) carrying a parcel.

events.summary: Border police saw a small aircraft (possible drone) fly from Ukraine toward Vicovu de Sus at 19:15 and return; three abandoned parcels of contraband cigarettes were found in the locality; 11,600 packs seized across the sector in 24 hours, part brought by drone.
events.payload_detail: 11,600 packs seized in 24 h sector-wide, part by drone (drone share not stated)
events.source_title: Peste 11.000 de pachete cu țigări de contrabandă, confiscate la frontiera cu Ucraina
events.quote: O parte din cantitatea de țigări a fost trecută peste frontieră, din Ucraina în România, cu ajutorul unei drone.
events.quote_translation: Part of the quantity of cigarettes was brought across the border from Ukraine into Romania by a drone.

events.place: Ukrainian-Polish border, Rivne border division area
events.summary: Rivne border guards heard an aircraft engine near the Polish border; Polish guards found a drone with 600 packs of cigarettes after an apparent emergency landing; drone and fuel confiscated.
events.payload_detail: 600 packs of cigarettes
events.source_title: Borderguards detected drones with cigarettes at the Ukrainian-Polish border
events.quote: At the same time, Polish borderguards detected an aircraft and 600 packs of cigarettes.

events.summary: Operation Etxea: Guardia Civil dismantled in November 2021 a Ceuta network passing hashish by drone. On 9 July 2025 the Audiencia de Cádiz (Section VI, Ceuta) convicted all 10 defendants by agreement; four as authors got 3 years 1 day, plus fines. Reported as first such sentence in Spain.
events.payload_detail: hashish
events.source_title: Condena pionera en Ceuta contra una red de narcodrones
events.quote: El tribunal de la Sección VI de la Audiencia de Cádiz en Ceuta ha dictado este miércoles una condena por conformidad para los 10 acusados de formar una red en Ceuta dedicada a pasar hachís en drones.
events.quote_translation: The Section VI court of the Audiencia de Cádiz in Ceuta today handed down a sentence by agreement on the 10 accused of forming a network in Ceuta dedicated to passing hashish by drone.

events.summary: Border guards found four local residents in a car with 16 drone batteries, a laptop, remote controls, radios and a thermal imager near Huta; Slovak guards detained a man with two packages of tobacco products.
events.source_title: Air smuggling: Ukrainian border guards detained alleged drone operators while their Slovak colleagues detained the cigarette recipient
events.quote: They found 16 batteries for a drone, a laptop, several remote controls and radio sets, a battery charger and a thermal imager in the car.

events.summary: A woman flew a drone package to a third-floor cell window at HMP Peterborough: 10 miniature phones, cannabis, tobacco. Police put the prison value at 5,800 GBP (cannabis) and 3,000 GBP (tobacco). One-year sentence suspended for two years, 150 hours unpaid work.
events.payload_detail: 10 miniature phones, cannabis, tobacco, cigarette papers
events.source_title: Woman used drone to smuggle phones and drugs into HMP Peterborough
events.quote: Prison officers were alerted to the drone flying within the grounds and witnessed it approach a third-floor window where the occupant took it through a hole in his window.

events.summary: Commissariato Vicaria Mercato arrested a 43-year-old under house arrest who used a drone from his terrace to monitor police and Carabinieri movements; 130 g heroin and 1,755 euro found. Investigators did not rule out drone deliveries to customers.
events.payload_detail: 130 g heroin (found at home, not on the drone)
events.source_title: Napoli: usava un drone per controllare spostamenti di Polizia e Carabinieri, pusher arrestato
events.quote: Napoli: usava un drone per controllare spostamenti di Polizia e Carabinieri, pusher arrestato
events.quote_translation: Naples: used a drone to monitor Police and Carabinieri movements, pusher arrested
