events.summary: Policía Nacional and Guardia Civil dismantled a Ceuta network passing hashish from Morocco by drone; four arrested and drones seized. Local press calls it the first such operation in Spain.
events.payload_detail: hashish
events.source_title: Operación conjunta, buenos resultados
events.quote: Ceuta fue escenario ayer de una operación pionera en España que ha desmantelado una red dedicada al pase de hachís en narcodrones.
events.quote_translation: Ceuta was yesterday the scene of an operation, a first in Spain, that has dismantled a network dedicated to passing hashish by narco-drone.

events.summary: Police found a group receiving alpha-PVP sent by drone from Ivangorod, Russia, across the Narva river into Narva; six such deliveries were found in the investigation and the group was caught on the sixth. Four people were suspected, three in custody.
events.payload_detail: alpha-PVP (quantity not stated)
events.source_title: Politsei tabas mullu Narvas kaks droone kasutanud salakaubavedajate gruppi
events.quote: Narkootikumid saadeti Ivangorodist drooniga üle Narva jõe Narva linna. Meie avastasime kriminaalmenetluse käigus kuus sellist korda. Kuuendal korral pidasime nad kinni.
events.quote_translation: The drugs were sent from Ivangorod by drone across the Narva river to the town of Narva. We found six such occasions in the criminal proceedings. On the sixth occasion we detained them.

events.place: HMP Onley, Rugby, and HMP Gartree, Leicestershire
events.summary: Three men jailed at Wolverhampton Crown Court (6y6m, 5y6m, 7y3m) and a former Staffordshire Police detective constable given a suspended two-year sentence, for drone drops of drugs, tobacco and phones into HMP Onley and HMP Gartree in 2021-2022.
events.payload_detail: Class A and B drugs, tobacco, phones; one package heroin and cannabis
events.source_title: Smugglers jailed for using drones to drop contraband into prison near Rugby
events.quote: Let this case send a clear message to anyone thinking of engaging in similar behaviour

events.summary: Prison police neutralised a large Europe-built drone, valued at about 10,000 euro, near Poggioreale prison. It carried 1 kg of hashish, cocaine and marijuana, a precision scale and 15 smartphones with cables and chargers.
events.payload_detail: 1 kg hashish, cocaine and marijuana; precision scale; 15 smartphones with cables and chargers
events.source_title: Drone da 10mila euro intercettato sul carcere di Poggioreale: trasportava droga e 15 smartphone
events.quote: la Polizia Penitenziaria questa volta ha neutralizzato un drone di grandi dimensioni
events.quote_translation: the Prison Police this time neutralised a large drone

events.summary: Švenčionys border guards heard and thermally imaged a home-made unmanned aircraft from Belarus, brought it down with anti-drone equipment and found just over 600 packs of Minsk City QS cigarettes with Belarusian stamps and a GPS transmitter attached.
events.payload_detail: just over 600 packs Minsk City QS cigarettes, GPS tracker attached
events.source_title: Švenčionių rajone pasieniečiai perėmė ir nutupdė kontrabandininkų lėktuvėlį su cigaretėmis
events.quote: Švenčionių rajone pasieniečiai perėmė ir nutupdė iš Baltarusijos pusės atskridusį kontrabandininkų lėktuvėlį su cigaretėmis, pranešė Valstybės sienos apsaugos tarnyba (VSAT).
events.quote_translation: In Švenčionys district border guards intercepted and landed a smugglers' small aircraft with cigarettes that flew in from the Belarusian side, the State Border Guard Service (VSAT) reported.

events.summary: Two off-duty prison police inspectors spotted and stopped a car with three people piloting a drone over Terni prison; seized 12,000 euro cash and four mobile phones destined for inmates.
events.payload_detail: 4 mobile phones, 12,000 euro cash
events.source_title: Terni: intercettati mentre indirizzano drone sul carcere con quattro cellulari e 12mila euro per i detenuti
events.quote: hanno individuato e bloccato l’auto con a bordo tre soggetti intenti a pilotare il drone in sorvolo sul carcere
events.quote_translation: identified and stopped the car carrying three people piloting the drone flying over the prison

events.summary: Per Lithuania's Prosecutor General's Office, 33,000 packs of Queen Menthol cigarettes worth over EUR 148,000 were moved from Belarus by drones on the night of 27 October 2024. Two border officers allegedly arranged colleagues' absence. Case sent to court against six defendants, Dec 2025.
events.payload_detail: 33,000 packs Queen Menthol cigarettes, over EUR 148,000 incl. taxes
events.source_title: Contraband Smugglers and Two Border Officers to Stand Trial in Lithuania for Drone-Based Cigarette Trafficking
events.quote: According to the Prosecutor General’s Office, during the night of 27 October last year, 33,000 packs of Queen Menthol cigarettes were transported from Belarus to Lithuania using drones.

events.summary: Border guards and ESBU detectives seized nine boxes (4,500 packs) of unstamped cigarettes from a car in Uzhhorod; the men were said to intend to move them to Slovakia by drone. No drone recovered.
events.payload_detail: 4,500 packs
events.source_title: "Закарпатці планували дроном переправити сигарети до Словаччини": в Ужгороді прикордонники вилучили 4500 пачок сигарет
events.quote: За наявною інформацією, чоловіки мали намір за допомогою дрона переправити з України до Словаччини партію тютюнових виробів
events.quote_translation: According to available information, the men intended to move a batch of tobacco products from Ukraine to Slovakia by drone.

events.summary: Unidentified persons flew a drone near Peqin prison and dropped two packages holding about 380 g hashish and 58 g cocaine; drone and drugs seized; investigation into the senders and the inmates awaiting them.
events.payload_detail: approx 380 g hashish, 58 g cocaine
events.source_title: Droni në Burgun e Peqinit/ U hodhën dy pako me 380 gramë hashash, rreth 58 gramë kokainë
events.quote: Burgjet zbardhin detaje të ngjarjes së ndodhur mbrëmë, ku persona të paidentifikuar lëshuan mjetin fluturues pranë institucionit dhe hodhën prej andej pakot me sende të paligjshme.
events.quote_translation: The prison service gives details of last evening's event, in which unidentified persons launched the flying vehicle near the institution and dropped the packages of illegal items from it.

events.summary: A trade union official said parcels are often delivered by drone almost into cells at Merksplas prison, helped by broken windows. No incident, date, arrest or seizure is given.
events.source_title: Antwerpse cipiers klagen met staking ook staat van gebouwen aan: "Overal ongedierte en asbest"
events.quote: Met drones worden er daar vaak pakketjes tot bijna letterlijk in de cel geleverd waar de gedetineerden dankzij die kapotte ruiten aan kunnen.
events.quote_translation: Drones are often used there to deliver packages almost literally into the cell, which inmates can reach thanks to those broken windows.

events.place: Volyn and Lviv oblasts (smugglers' homes and outbuildings)
events.summary: Border guards with Dozor unit busted a Volyn smuggling group using UAVs to send cigarettes abroad and to watch border patrols; eight UAVs, a hang glider, 2,000+ packs counterfeit tobacco and a 3D-printer drone workshop seized.
events.payload_detail: 2,000+ packs counterfeit tobacco seized
events.source_title: Ukraine dismantles hi-tech contraband ring that used drones for smuggling cigarettes and monitoring border patrols
events.quote: They used UAVs not only to send cigarettes abroad, but also to monitor the actions of border patrols,

events.summary: Prison staff spotted a drone over Saint-Gilles prison at about 9 am and intercepted it. A packet on a wire held glue, a phone charger and marijuana. Police were informed; no arrests reported.
events.payload_detail: marijuana, glue, phone charger
events.source_title: Un drone transportant de la drogue a été intercepté à la prison de Saint-Gilles
events.quote: un drone qui était supposé déposer de la drogue à l'intérieur de la prison
events.quote_translation: a drone that was supposed to drop drugs inside the prison

events.summary: A drone and a trolley case of contraband cigarettes landed in a resident's yard in Straja, 1 km from the Ukrainian border; Vicovu de Sus police took the case.
events.source_title: O femeie din Suceava s-a trezit în curte cu un troler plin cu țigări
events.quote: Femeia din Suceava a găsit în curte un troler plin cu țigări și o dronă. Polițiștii din cadrul Poliției Vicovu de Sus se ocupă în continuare de acest caz.
events.quote_translation: The Suceava woman found a trolley full of cigarettes and a drone in her yard. Vicovu de Sus police are still handling the case.

events.summary: Instagram video shows a drone flying over the prison wall and inmates pulling a taped package through a ventilation grate into a cell with string and hook. Package not intercepted; two inmates punished.
events.payload_detail: contents unconfirmed; witnesses mention phones and cannabis
events.source_title: Zo hengelen gevangenen met drone afgeleverde drugs en telefoon binnen
events.quote: contrabande via drones tegen te gaan
events.quote_translation: to counter contraband via drones

events.place: Prison (PI, name anonymised in judgment), Netherlands
events.summary: Prison report cited in summary proceedings on a detainee's placement: phone data and video show a drone dropping at a prison exercise yard, with further drone deliveries ordered. Court treats it as suspicion of continued crime from detention.
events.payload_detail: ordered: 3 iPhones and EUR 750 of narcotics, to be delivered by drone

events.quote_translation: Video footage was found on this mobile phone of a drone, showing a drop onto an exercise yard inside the PI [place 3].

events.summary: Two camouflaged drones carrying drugs, phones, cables and chargers landed on the prison exercise yard on two nights of one weekend. Nobody arrested; items handed to police.
events.payload_detail: considerable amount of drugs, several phones, cables, chargers
events.source_title: Twee drones met daarin drugs en telefoons onderschept op luchtplaats JC Zaanstad
events.quote: De smokkelwaar is overgedragen aan de politie.
events.quote_translation: The contraband was handed over to the police.

events.place: Halmeu, Satu Mare County (orchard 1,500 m from the Ukrainian border)
events.summary: Halmeu border police saw a small drone carrying a parcel at 23:30 and found about 3,000 packs of cigarettes wrapped in black foil in an orchard 1,500 m from the border; a Romanian citizen who was to store them is under investigation.
events.payload_detail: approx 3,000 packs of cigarettes
events.source_title: Contrabandă cu țigări din Ucraina, cu drona, peste graniță
events.quote: În data de 11.08.2021, în jurul orei 23.30, poliţiştii de frontieră din cadrul Sectorului P.F. Halmeu – judeţul Satu Mare, aflaţi în misiune de supraveghere a frontierei de stat, au observat, pe direcţia localităţii Halmeu, un aparat de zbor de mici dimensiuni (dronă), care transporta un colet.
events.quote_translation: On 11.08.2021, around 23:30, border police of Halmeu sector, Satu Mare county, on border surveillance duty, observed in the direction of Halmeu a small aircraft (drone) carrying a parcel.

events.summary: Operation Piñas, run by French and Spanish police under a European Investigation Order. Three people were arrested in France with 12 kg of hashish; a fourth was detained in Málaga with a drone with a 4.35 m wingspan and seven-hour flight capacity, modified to carry drugs from Morocco.
events.payload_detail: 12 kg hashish seized in France
events.source_title: Franco-Spanish raid busts criminals using souped-up drone to transport drugs
events.quote: Authorities said the criminals had modified the drone to be able to transport drugs from Morocco to Malaga.

events.place: Rivne section, Lutsk Border Detachment, Volyn Oblast
events.summary: Around midnight border guards found a UAV and a parcel of 500 packs of cigarettes prepared for transfer to the Polish side; a separate patrol found 2,000 packs moved from Belarus by a purpose-built device.
events.payload_detail: 500 packs prepared for transfer
events.source_title: На Волині затримали безпілотник, який мав перевезти сигарети до Польщі (фото)
events.quote: близько опівночі військовослужбовці відділу «Рівне», реалізовуючи оперативну інформацію, виявили в прикордонні безпілотний літальний апарат. Поряд знаходився пакунок з 500 пачками сигарет
events.quote_translation: around midnight, servicemen of the Rivne unit, acting on operational information, found an unmanned aerial vehicle in the border area. Next to it was a parcel of 500 packs of cigarettes.

events.summary: Hungarian tax and customs authority (NAV) and police met smugglers using drones and unmanned aircraft at the Ukrainian-Hungarian green border, tracked them by thermal camera, and seized over 6,700 boxes of cigarettes and two aircraft.
events.payload_detail: more than 6,700 boxes of cigarettes
events.source_title: Cigarettacsempészet drónnal
events.quote: A légi eszközöket az orgazdák az ukrán-magyar határnál vetették be, a pénzügyőrök pedig hőkamerákkal követték útjukat. Ennek eredményeképpen több mint 6700 doboz cigarettát és két gépet találtak és foglaltak le.
events.quote_translation: The smugglers used the aircraft at the Ukrainian-Hungarian border and customs officers tracked them with thermal cameras. As a result, more than 6,700 boxes of cigarettes and two machines were found and seized.
